title: Vulnerability in OptimiDoc Server (On-Premise) software
content_md: Plaintext Storage of a Password vulnerability (CVE-2026-15933) has been found in OptimiDoc Server (On-Premise) software. Article Link: Vulnerability in OptimiDoc Server (On-Premise) software | CERT Polska
